query.title: Company name or registration number
query.description: A company name (English or Nepali, partial names work) or an OCR registration number (e.g. 350011) to search for.

queries.title: Company names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

searchBy.title: Search field
searchBy.description: Which field each query is matched against. "Auto-detect" (default) treats a digits-only query as a registration number and anything else as a company name (Nepali script is matched against the Nepali name field automatically).

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched company records to keep per search query. The registry does substring matching with no server-side page size, so a broad common-word query can match many thousands of companies -- this caps how many are pushed to the dataset.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
